observation.alert_summary: Payment authorization is unavailable while the process remains live.

signals.summary: Payment readiness and authorization failures increased after a configuration change.
Payment returns a bounded configuration-unavailable error without credential content.
Order requests fail at the Payment dependency span.
No service version transition accompanies the failure.

observation.alert_summary: Order requests time out while waiting for PostgreSQL connections.

signals.summary: Order database acquisition duration and HTTP failures increased together.
Order reports a bounded database-unavailable classification.
Order spans end before a PostgreSQL command is issued.
No new Order service version is active.

observation.alert_summary: Checkout latency rises while Payment authorization is slow.

signals.summary: Payment client duration and Order P95 latency rise in the same window.
Order reports a bounded downstream timeout.
The Payment client span dominates the checkout critical path.
No deployment transition correlates with the onset.

observation.alert_summary: Order POST requests return internal errors after a release.

signals.summary: Order HTTP 500 responses increased immediately after the release.
Order request logs contain bounded internal-error outcomes.
Order server spans fail before any dependency child span.
Order transitioned from version 1.0.0 to version 2.0.0 in the incident window.

observation.alert_summary: Order memory grows with traffic after a release.

signals.summary: Order retained memory rises monotonically with request count.
Order request outcomes remain bounded while memory pressure grows.
Request traces complete but latency begins to drift upward.
Order transitioned from version 1.0.0 to version 2.0.0 before growth began.

observation.alert_summary: Inventory reservations fail while Redis calls time out.

signals.summary: Inventory Redis timeout and HTTP 503 outcomes increase together.
Inventory reports a bounded dependency-timeout classification.
Inventory spans end at the Redis dependency boundary.
No Inventory service version transition accompanies the failure.
